image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a baby bib lying flat on a textured pink surface. The bib features a white central panel with blue and white striped trim around the edges and neck. It has an embroidered design in the center depicting a tiered cake or stack of items. The neck closure appears to be a tie made of the same striped fabric.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The embroidered cake design lacks clear thread definition; it appears slightly smudged or 'painted on' rather than stitched, which is a common AI artifact in rendering fine textile details.
The ties at the top left and right merge into the background and each other without clear physical separation or knot logic. The fabric folds look unnatural and slightly melted.

The stripes on the trim follow the curve well, but the width of the trim varies inconsistently, particularly on the left side where it seems to widen and narrow abruptly without corresponding fabric tension.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a bib and not a similar textile item like a placemat or doily.
To verify the physical continuity of the trim and ensure the ties are distinct objects connected to the main body, checking for fusion artifacts.
To analyze the realism of the woven texture and the embroidered design, looking for smudging or lack of micro-detail typical in AI generations.

focus_areas: Realism of the embroidered graphic (thread definition vs. blur)
Consistency of the striped pattern along the curved border
Texture coherence between the white center and striped trim
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'ties' at the neck. In AI images, these often fail to separate cleanly from the background or the main bib body. Also, inspect the central embroidery: does it look like actual thread stitches, or just a blurry print? Check if the striped pattern maintains consistent width around the curves.
